# Oral-B UK

> Oral-B UK provides electric and manual toothbrushes, oral care products, and health education with a focus on clinically-proven cleaning and accessible dentistry.

Oral-B UK is the British branch of the Procter & Gamble oral care brand, offering a comprehensive range of toothbrushes, toothpastes, mouthwashes, and irrigation devices. The site combines product information, oral health education for all life stages, and customer support resources.

## Key Topics

- Electric Toothbrushes
- Manual Toothbrushes
- Kids Toothbrushes
- Whitening Toothpaste
- Oral Care Products
- Teeth Whitening
- Gum Health
- Plaque Removal
- Connectivity Issues
- Oral Health Education
- Stannous Fluoride
- Disability-Inclusive Dentistry
- Children's Dental Health
- Product Support
- Oral-B Professional

## Troubleshooting & Support

- [Support Hub](https://www.oralb.co.uk/en-gb/contact-us): Oral-B customer support contact and help center hub
- [Issues with connectivity | Oral-B UK](https://www.oralb.co.uk/en-gb/support/connectivity-issues): Troubleshooting guide for toothbrush app connectivity problems
- [Toothbrush position detection not working | Oral-B UK](https://www.oralb.co.uk/en-gb/support/connectivity-issues/position-detection-not-working): Troubleshoot Oral-B app position detection issues via Bluetooth

- [My toothbrush is moldy or has a moldy smell | Oral-B UK](https://www.oralb.co.uk/en-gb/support/other-issues/my-toothbrush-is-moldy-or-has-a-moldy-smell): Cleaning and maintenance guide for moldy toothbrushes
